decisions.reason: The dynamic next-draw counter is independently owned by the public-statistics Requirement; the mechanics-copy Requirement already records the distinct copy changes from this message.
A sales-remaining counter for the next draw does not change ticket issuance, association, dashboard ticket display, or ticket-counter reset behavior.
The source adds a landing-page live statistic but does not require that counter to be part of the hero section; the hero-specific changes are already represented separately.
The live next-draw counter does not change the FAQ content state; the FAQ-specific statements in the source message already have their own same-message MODIFY.
Displaying estimated sales remaining until a draw does not change winner announcement, notification, or guidance channels.
The source decision does not require the next-draw counter to appear on the About page; its process-copy revisions are independently represented.
The public draw counter does not alter the book cover's display surface or placement.
The next-draw counter is not required on the Mission page and does not change its approved content sections.
The counter displays progress toward the already established 100-sales draw; it does not change the Small Block prize amount, trigger, eligibility, funding, or reset mechanics.
A live sales-remaining counter does not change the randomness provider, eligible population, ticket weighting, or winner-selection execution.
The next-draw sales counter does not change when tickets are issued, who receives them, their quantity, or their lifecycle.
Displaying progress toward the next draw does not alter automatic direct-wallet prize delivery.
